title: How do you install GenStone panels on a foundation (concrete, brick, stucco)? - GenStone
text:
How do you install GenStone panels on a foundation (concrete, brick, stucco)?

Installation is the same process as other surfaces, but for masonry you typically use Tapcons. Start with a level line, stagger seams, cut panels to fit, use the proper amount of adhesive, and caulk connections and termination points per GenStone installation instructions.
